cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: Verse literature exams test translation, analysis of poetic features, and evaluation of themes and characterisation — always with reference to the Latin text.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: When analysing style, always PEA: Point (name the feature), Evidence (quote the Latin), Analysis (explain the effect on the reader).

cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: Common poetic features to discuss: alliteration, enjambement, elision, caesura, onomatopoeia, hyperbaton, simile, metaphor, and word order.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: For evaluation questions on character or theme, structure your answer with an introduction, 3-4 paragraphs each with a Latin quotation, and a conclusion.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: When asked about metre, identify the metre (hexameter for epic) and discuss how rhythm contributes to meaning.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: Comparison questions: identify similarities AND differences, using connectives like 'whereas', 'similarly', 'in contrast'.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: Character questions: consider how the author presents them (own words, others' reactions, narrator's commentary) and why.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: Theme questions: track how a theme develops across the prescribed passages, showing its complexity.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: Time management: allow approximately 1 minute per mark.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Verse Literature Exam Technique
cards.back: Never write a paragraph without a Latin quotation in it — every analytical point needs textual evidence.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse latin exam tips — verse literature exam technique?
cards.back: 1. For Verse Literature Exam Technique, use a range of vocabulary and complex grammatical structures to access higher marks 2. Check verb tenses, agreements and word order carefully in your written work 3. In translation tasks, translate meaning rather than word-for-word 4. When writing about Verse Literature Exam Technique, include opinions and justifications, not just descriptions 5. For listening and reading, focus on key words and cognates to extract meaning
